leo (AE): Quick sync Prospect wants BYOK + HSM with a 2-week POC. They also flagged SIG/CAIQ gaps around key rotation proofs and want no plaintext keys leaving their environment. Can we list required artifacts and a short tech note for their security team?
jin (SEC): We can do BYOK without ever receiving plaintext keys. Supported modes: external KMS proxy (EKM), wrapped DEKs (customer wraps with KEK), and client-side encryption where they keep DEKs. For HSM evidence we'll point to partner cert pages (CloudHSM, Azure DHSM, Thales Luna).
leo (AE): They asked for example CAIQ answers for the controls: CRR (key rotation) and KIM (key import/export). Can you draft minimal language we can paste?
jin (SEC): Draft snippets: - "Customer key material remains under customer control. Redwood integrates with external KMS/HSM via wrapped key import or EKM proxy and does not request plaintext keys." - "Rotation: Customers may schedule KEK rotations; Redwood will accept new wrapped DEKs and will emit rotation events to customer SIEM. Typical rotation acceptance latency < 2 minutes (depends on transfer)."
olga (SRE): For Private installs the handshake options: (A) mTLS KMS proxy where calls are forwarded to customer KMS (no key material stored), (B) offline wrapped bundle import signed by customer admin, (C) bring-your-own-DEK where app payloads arrive encrypted by customer key. Note: if using EKM, we need outbound TLS to their KMS endpoints and a short-lived client cert.
diego (SE): Latency impact: unwrap happens at container start or rotation window. For warm workloads we cache DEKs in memory for TTL; no per-request unwrap. Expect 30-200ms on unwrap depending on region. Also mention egress costs if external KMS is cross-cloud.
leo (AE): They want rotation every 90 days plus a proof of rotation events for auditors. What does the log look like?
olga (SRE): We emit structured events (json) with fields: event_type, key_id_hash, rotation_ts, actor, operation_result. Example shipped in runbook. We can stream to syslog (TCP/TLS), HTTPS webhook, or forwarder agent to their SIEM.
jin (SEC): Also add: FIPS evidence we can provide is partner attestation and our integration checklist. Note FIPS 140-3 is newer; many HSM partners have 140-2 and some have 140-3. We'll include cert scans and dates.
leo (AE): Any blockers for a 2-week POC?
diego (SE): Dependencies: 1) Admin contact + PKI cert for mTLS or signed import bundle, 2) KMS/HSM vendor and endpoint, 3) target rotation cadence and TTL for DEK cache, 4) SIEM endpoint and preferred ingestion format, 5) whether they accept outbound connectivity from the appliance. If air-gapped we'll use offline import steps which add 2-3 days.
jin (SEC): Security Qs we'll answer in the SIG: key custody (we don't hold plaintext), rotation proof (audit events), HSM cert chain (links), and key compromise plan (revocation + rewrap workflow).
leo (AE): Pricing: they asked if HSM adds recurring cost vs our default encrypted-at-rest. Short answer?
diego (SE): Yes: HSM/KMS (customer side) has its own costs; if we proxy to their KMS there's minimal Redwood infra delta except egress. If they want Redwood-managed HSM (rare) that's a different add-on. I'll produce an estimated delta for their token volume.
leo (AE): Can someone produce the presales packet (1 page tech note + ask list + runbook link) by EOD?
olga (SRE): Uploaded initial runbook skeleton: https://drive.redwood/poctemplates/byo-hsm-runbook.md  contains import script and sample rotation logs. Will finish details by morning.
jin (SEC): I posted CAIQ answer snippets in the security wiki: https://wiki.redwood/security/caqi-kms-snippets and will convert to spreadsheet for the customer questionnaire.
oncall-bot: Ticket POC-789 created for BYOK/HSM presales (owner: leo).
leo (AE): Thanks all. I'll tell the customer we can start once they send PKI material and endpoint list. :thumbsup:
